name: Kunisaki Tsuzuri
source:
2nd year high school student.
An optimistic and hard working, slightly gluttonous girl.
She's from a family of fortune tellers and has a good sense for the supernatural and can sense the future and peoples inner thoughts.
But she herself thinks it isn't anything special and is just normal prophetic dreams that anyone could see.
But her mother suddenly disappears and in order to keep earning money for the family finances she has to seriously become a fortune teller.
